summary: Approve the scoped source package. All 22 bodies match the supplied instruction bytes tied to module SHA-256, RVA and slice hashes. Narrow stores preserve upper EAX bits; constant setters preserve entry EAX; predicates return exact full-width 0/1; both ECX-loading predicates retain raw loaded bits. Exact-width GuestMemory operations preserve unaligned byte layout without guest-to-host pointer casts or typed aliasing assumptions. The multi-access functions preserve instruction access order, and their field footprints are disjoint within valid arena bounds. Clamp subtraction and narrowing implement modulo-256 behavior; shifts and address arithmetic use defined unsigned semantics. Supplied tested-source/reference/contract bindings, successful AppleClang ARM64 builds, repeated public/heldout comparisons and all 22 post-candidate negative controls corroborate this source analysis.
